stories.headline: UNSC Passes Resolution on East African Ceasefire
stories.summary: The UN Security Council approved a resolution calling for an immediate ceasefire in the escalating East African conflict, aiming to halt humanitarian crisis.

stories.headline: European Consortium Achieves Quantum Computing Stability Breakthrough
stories.summary: Scientists announced a significant leap in quantum computing stability, potentially accelerating next-gen AI and drug discovery.

stories.headline: Global Markets React to Unexpected US Federal Reserve Rate Hike
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve's surprise interest rate increase sent ripples through global markets, raising concerns about economic slowdown.

stories.headline: WHO Warns of New Viral Variant Spread Amid Global Travel Surge
stories.summary: The World Health Organization issued an alert regarding a highly transmissible new viral variant, urging caution as international travel increases.

stories.headline: Southeast Asia Battles Record Monsoon Flooding, Millions Displaced
stories.summary: Unprecedented monsoon rains caused severe flooding across Southeast Asia, leading to widespread displacement and urgent humanitarian aid calls.
